Within-psalm verse numbers were also checked against content. 思高 Ps 39 v.11 is rendered 'a fortitudine manus tuae' content. For Vulgate 38:12 second half 'vane conturbatur omnis homo': 思高 39:12 uses '至于人，不过只是一口气' (vapor); Latin means 'troubled in vain' — rendered in 思高 style as '至于人，不过只是白白忧虑' to reflect both senses. Hermoniim (41:7): 思高 Ps 42:7 has 赫尔孟山 (Mount Hermon); rendered as 赫尔孟山. 思高 Ps 42:5 is long; the * mediant split distributes the two halves around 'usque ad domum Dei'.
